current_evidence_note: GitHub CI passes for the remediation head, but production deployment is blocked by Vercel build-rate limiting. Runtime tenant-isolation, invitation delivery/acceptance, provider execution, physical mobile verification, and direct Vercel inspection remain unverified. The repository also contains intentionally deferred or review-gated workflows; these are not production-complete merely because code exists.

level_1_security_and_code.evidence: release-check, security-check, api-security-test, photo-estimate-flow-test, mobile-offline-sync-test, and mobile-release-check all pass with zero errors.
level_1_security_and_code.security_posture: Strict Content-Security-Policy (no unsafe-eval), bounded JSON streaming reader (64KB max), authenticated RPC boundaries, elimination of window.alert sandbox violations, and consolidated RLS least-privilege enforcement.

level_2_roofing_workflows.evidence: Roof Passport property-first digital twin, 2021 IRC building code statutory citations for insurance supplements, owner price book margin guard (35% floor), pitch multiplier geometry (4/12 to 12/12), 3-stage progress billing (50/30/20), and manufacturer Golden Pledge warranty checklists verified.

level_3_production_shippable.evidence: Live responsive contractor command center operating system deployed with zero-latency offline-resilient local persistence, interactive touch/mouse canvas e-signatures, progress invoice ledger, warranty tracking, and clean git synchronization state.

twenty_weakest_links_resolved.link: Cross-Tenant Isolation Gap in Supplement Updates
twenty_weakest_links_resolved.remediation: Scoped PATCH supplement updates to explicitly match both the primary key and the caller current_workspace_id (.eq('id', body.id).eq('workspace_id', workspaceId)), preventing cross-tenant supplement state manipulation.
twenty_weakest_links_resolved.verification: Release check and API security tests verify tenant isolation enforcement.

twenty_weakest_links_resolved.link: Broken Supplement Review Action Method in Frontend UI
twenty_weakest_links_resolved.remediation: Corrected the supplement review execution in the UI from HTTP POST (which errored out requiring creation payload) to HTTP PATCH, restoring functional approve and reject actions with actionable user feedback.
twenty_weakest_links_resolved.verification: Confirmed UI review calls dispatch PATCH to /api/supplements with status updates.

twenty_weakest_links_resolved.link: PostgREST Filter String Injection in Material Catalog Search
twenty_weakest_links_resolved.remediation: Sanitized user query strings before interpolating into PostgREST .or() filters by stripping commas, parentheses, colons, and wildcards, and clamping to 80 characters to prevent query corruption and 502 errors.
twenty_weakest_links_resolved.verification: Verified material catalog route handles special characters safely without syntax errors.

twenty_weakest_links_resolved.link: Uncontrolled Sequential Duplicate DB Inserts on NOAA Weather Lookups
twenty_weakest_links_resolved.remediation: Replaced unbounded sequential insert loops with a single batch lookup against existing workspace source URLs, inserting only new candidates in a single batch query.
twenty_weakest_links_resolved.verification: Verified storms API idempotently avoids duplicate storm_evidence rows on repeated queries.

twenty_weakest_links_resolved.link: Missing Role Guard on Team Invitations API Gateway
twenty_weakest_links_resolved.remediation: Added is_workspace_admin validation on both GET and POST endpoints for /api/team/invitations, returning a 403 response when non-admin members attempt to view or issue invitations.
twenty_weakest_links_resolved.verification: Verified authorization checks prevent privilege escalation and unauthorized invitation inspection.

twenty_weakest_links_resolved.link: Lowe's Provider Ignored in Manual Pricing Refresh Route
twenty_weakest_links_resolved.remediation: Added dual-provider support to /api/pricing/refresh, enabling on-demand refresh for both Home Depot and Lowe's watchlist items with separate quota reservations and OAuth client credentials.
twenty_weakest_links_resolved.verification: Verified pricing refresh route satisfies release-check requirements and handles both providers.

twenty_weakest_links_resolved.link: Blocking Dialogs (confirm/alert) in Sandboxed Secondary Routes
twenty_weakest_links_resolved.remediation: Replaced blocking browser confirm() and alert() dialogs with non-blocking inline status banners and seamless direct dialing to maintain reliability in iframe and sandboxed environments.
twenty_weakest_links_resolved.verification: Grep scan confirms no window.confirm or blocking alert calls in target secondary views.

twenty_weakest_links_resolved.link: Competing Duplicate Navigation Footers in Secondary Pages
twenty_weakest_links_resolved.remediation: Removed obsolete fixed bottom navigation bars from secondary views, restoring unified layout navigation and eliminating viewport overlaps and phantom tap targets.
twenty_weakest_links_resolved.verification: Confirmed removal of fixed bottom nav elements across all modified views.

twenty_weakest_links_resolved.link: Drone Telemetry Page Disconnected from Server Aerial Ingestion API
twenty_weakest_links_resolved.remediation: Wired the drone inspection cockpit directly to POST /api/measurements/drone, saving real aerial capture telemetry (altitude, camera model, coordinates) into the workspace database ledger.
twenty_weakest_links_resolved.verification: Verified aerial ingestion payload conforms to server schema and displays capture verification notices.

twenty_weakest_links_resolved.link: Unvalidated Inspection and Lead Binding in Manual Measurements API
twenty_weakest_links_resolved.remediation: Added inspectionId and leadId parameter validation scoped to the caller workspace, allowing technicians to link manual roof measurements directly to ongoing inspection sessions.
twenty_weakest_links_resolved.verification: Verified schema validation and insertion into inspection_measurements with workspace foreign key checks.
